turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My storage is full again and I can't even take a picture.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. Do you want to pay for cloud storage, or clear things out by hand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, both sound kind of bad.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They each have a cost, time or money. Which one would you rather spend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a minute, my friend just walked in. Don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did the landlord say anything about painting the walls?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: She said it's fine as long as it's a light colour.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So no dark green bedroom then.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Probably not. Maybe a pale green?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I guess. Do you want to go to the hardware shop on Saturday and look at samples?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure, if we can get breakfast first.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Obviously. That's half the reason to go.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. We were stuck on time versus money for your phone storage.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll clean it up myself. I probably have a thousand blurry photos anyway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with videos, they take the most space. Sorting by size will show you the biggest ones first.
